text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the hallway...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As expected of you! Ines-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Spreading the wax so evenly across the floor while Bakushin-ing...
Truly, a work of art!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "No, no, you're exaggerating! It's just 'cause I'm used to it from my cleaning job."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! However, returning kindness is proper etiquette for a class representative! Please, allow me to thank you properly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha! If you're going that far, let's see...
Next time, I want you to come with me to a supermarket sale!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course! Leave it to me!!" any
After that, everywhere they went around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—The probability of Ines-san
being a cyborg has risen to 45%.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? All you did was cut some carrots, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. However, upon executing measurements,
both thickness and cutting angle were found to be uniform.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, I see.
I just picked it up from working part-time at a bento shop♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Increase in proficiency through continuation. Understood.
Probability of being a cyborg decreased to 0%.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
With this, I can replenish my nutrition exactly according to the data.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Call me if you need help again!
Food processors are... pretty tricky to handle!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You're pretty handy at checking horseshoes, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mine's a bit special, so even the shop staff have a tough time with it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It is a rather unusual horseshoe, but don't worry!
We get all kinds of customers at my part-time job!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"They're all experts.
Maybe I should visit Ines's part-time workplace sometime!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong-dang-dong♪
For guests like you, we have some exciting news!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this! If you buy horseshoes right now...
you get the second one at half price! Please drop by♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha, smoothly segueing into a sales pitch, are we?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm simply reading
supply and demand accurately, that's all♪"
A little while after that, during a training meeting with Ines Fujin, I talked about the impressive things I saw her doing around the academy today.
choice_data_list: Everyone really relies on you, don't they?
Everyone really relies on you, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Feel like praising me some more?
Go right ahead, keep 'em coming!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Just kidding! Ahaha, only joking.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You see,
I'm doing that for my own sake too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Helping people comes with sweet perks anyway!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The one being helped is happy!
The one helping is happy too! Everyone's happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Truly killing two birds with one stone!
Then there's no reason not to do it, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Some of the girls worry and ask,
'Don't you get tired?' but—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the kind of person who gets energized
by seeing everyone's smiles!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why
I can do my best with part-time jobs and helping out.
choice_data_list: Looks like it'll build up quite a lot of stamina.
Looks like it'll build up quite a lot of stamina.
Looks like there's a lot to learn.
Looks like there's a lot to learn, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why
I can do my best with part-time jobs and helping out.

Looks like it'll build up quite a lot of stamina.
Looks like there's a lot to learn.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! That's so true!
I feel like my stamina's really improved lately!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's not two birds with one stone,
that's three birds with one stone?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Such great value for money! I'm totally feeling motivated now!
I'll keep doing my best!

And so, Ines Fujin was more motivated than ever
to help people out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Just the other day,
I helped out the student council with sorting documents!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, one thing led to another! And then
we talked about racing over coffee,
and I learned so much from it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Being able to casually pop in anywhere might just
be one of the best parts of this job~♪
